summary: An indeterminate activity indicator for short waits and busy controls. For content that is loading into a layout, use Skeleton; for long tasks, use Progress.
whenToUse: Inside a control that is working: Button and IconButton show it automatically with loading.
Small regions that refresh in place, for waits up to a few seconds.
tone signal when it stands alone, current when it sits in text or a control.
whenNotToUse: First load of a list or a page: use Skeleton in the shape of the content.
Tasks with measurable progress or that take longer than a few seconds: use Progress.

dos.title: Name what is loading
dos.text: A standalone spinner needs a label so screen readers hear "Loading tokens".

donts.title: A spinner in the middle of an empty page
donts.text: It hides the layout and makes the wait feel longer. Show the frame and use skeletons.

accessibility: With label it renders role="status" and is announced; without label it is aria-hidden (use it inside a control that sets aria-busy).
Under reduced motion it keeps turning, slower: a frozen spinner looks like a crash.
The arc is drawn in currentColor or the signal color, which keeps 3:1 against surfaces.
contentGuidelines: Labels name the content: "Loading tokens", "Checking contrast". Never just "Loading...".
